changes._why: WWI_PURCHASING_I_01 assumes every order has lines and every line an expected price, which nothing enforces; a check guards both
changes.title: Purchase orders the amounts cannot count
request: WWI_PURCHASING_I_01 sums the lines of each order at their expected prices, which assumes every order has a line and every line an expected price; the schema enforces neither.
Count the purchase orders with no line, and the lines with no expected price; the check passes when both are 0.
changes.sql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines pol WHERE pol.PurchaseOrderID = po.PurchaseOrderID)) AS OrdersWithoutLines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines WHERE ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter IS NULL)              AS LinesWithoutPrice
